records.summary: Cape Percar is the western peninsula wrapping Topal Bay, Soulrest's hinterland of burned mines, quarries, timber camps and coastal villages. Drier and hillier than the washes east of it, it carries the burn scar of the Great Burn.
records.landform: A forested peninsula of low hills and coastal flats, cut by tidal creeks, with mines in the hills and a burn-scarred strip.
records.biome: Coastal swamp forest and mangrove, with drier red-gum hills
records.climate: Warm, humid, with sea breezes and mist from the Sea of Mists; wet season floods the creeks.

notes.text: The cape is the peninsula behind Soulrest. It holds the old Imperial mines and timber concessions, a few villages and a burn scar. There is no UESP page for Cape Percar (searched 2026-11-08).

sources.title: Cape Percar region, its places on the map and the Soulrest dossier

notes.text: Gold and timber concessions ran here until the tribes burned them in 3E 427; the Great Burn's underground network reached the cape in 1E 2828.

records.summary: The Tulmek Washes are the flooded lowland between Soulrest's cape and the Lilmoth delta, centred on Blackrose's lake and its three rivers. A mosaic of channels, islands and ruins, it is the hinge of the south.
records.landform: Flat flooded lowland of river channels, lakes, mud islands and small dry rises, with the Blackrose lake at its heart.
records.climate: Hot, wet and still; annual flood cycle with boardwalk decks above wet-season level.

notes.text: The washes are the wet country around Blackrose where three rivers converge; Bramman's river runs out to Topal Bay. There is no UESP page for Tulmek Washes (searched 2026-11-08).

sources.title: Tulmek Washes region, the places between Soulrest and the Blackrose lakes

notes.text: Lilmothiit lands, then Kothringi towns, then the Imperial prison and city, then Red Bramman's kingdom; the 4E 48 catastrophe emptied Murkmire to the south-east.

notes.text: Blackrose city holds the lake; the Rose is held by the Blackguards' heirs; oxblood towns, rose delta villages and umber road towns sit around them.

records.summary: The Sea of Mists is the Southern Sea off Black Marsh's south coast, between Cape Percar and the Lilmoth coast, held under a low mist most mornings. Wrecks, small islands and a lighthouse mark it.
records.landform: Shallow shelf sea with sandbars and low islets off a drowned coast.
records.climate: Warm, humid, with sea mist on most mornings and storms in the wet season.

notes.text: The Sea of Mists is our name for the Southern Sea's water south of the cape; the map labels it Sea of Mists. There is no UESP page for the name; the Southern Sea page covers the body of water.

sources.title: Sea of Mists region, the water south of Cape Percar and the Tulmek Washes

notes.text: Canon: pirates of the Southern Sea avoid attention and a large share of seafarers are Khajiit; legend says Murkmire once extended further south and was swallowed by the sea.
